pages.title: Ms. Chalice Standing with Her Hands on Her Hips Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ms. Chalice standing with her hands on her hips, wearing her classic skirt and ballet flats with a cheerful smile. Her curled cup handles, striped straw, and scalloped hem add smaller details to the coloring sheet, while the plain background leaves her full figure clearly outlined.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Walking with Cuphead and Mugman Along an Inkwell Isle Path Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice walks between Cuphead and Mugman in this printable coloring page, following an Inkwell Isle path beside a fence and the shoreline. A lighthouse rises from a distant rocky island, while the three smiling characters fill the foreground of the coloring sheet with large shoes, gloves, and striped straws.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice as the Legendary Chalice Emerging From a Mausoleum Urn Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Ms. Chalice as the Legendary Chalice emerging from a decorated mausoleum urn, with open hands and a halo above her head. Curving handles and oval ornaments repeat across the character and vessel, while stone columns and a rounded arch frame this detailed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Legendary Chalice Showing Mugman a Cookie Coloring Page
pages.description: The Legendary Chalice shows Mugman an Astral Cookie outside Chef Saltbaker's bakery in this printable coloring page, floating beside the entrance with a welcoming smile. The star-marked cookie, striped awning, and flower box provide smaller sections on the coloring sheet, alongside Mugman's large gloves and rounded shoes.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Stepping Out of an Astral Plane Portal as Cuphead Becomes a Ghost Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ms. Chalice stepping through an Astral Plane portal as Cuphead becomes a ghost, his tapered tail floating beside her skirt. Swirling outlines and small diamond-shaped sparkles surround the portal, contrasting with the characters' broad clothing and face areas on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Studying Chef Saltbaker's Wondertart Recipe Inside His Bakery Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice studies Chef Saltbaker's Wondertart recipe in this printable coloring page, holding an open book illustrated with a tart, an egg, and a flour scoop. Bread-filled shelves, a mixing bowl, and kitchen containers establish the bakery setting, giving the coloring sheet a mix of broad character shapes and smaller baking details.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Double Jumping Toward the Bookmark in Her Recipe Book Tutorial Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ms. Chalice double jumping toward a hanging bookmark in her recipe book tutorial, with bent knees and raised gloved fists. The oversized open book surrounds her figure, leaving broad blank page areas on the coloring sheet, while the ribbon and curved motion lines mark her upward path.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Dash Parrying a Floating Grain in Her Recipe Book Tutorial Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice dash parries a floating grain in this printable coloring page, stretching forward across an open recipe book with both feet off the page. A pointed burst surrounds the grain, and sweeping speed lines follow her movement across the coloring sheet, contrasting with the book's large empty surfaces.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Dodge Rolling Past an Astral Tear in Her Recipe Book Tutorial Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Ms. Chalice dodge rolling past an Astral Tear during her recipe book tutorial, crouching low with her hands held together. The tear has a central star and surrounding sparkles, while curved motion lines and layered book edges add smaller details to the otherwise open coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Using Spiral Pillar to Send an Energy Beam Straight Upward Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice sends an energy beam straight upward with Spiral Pillar in this printable coloring page, standing beneath a tall column wrapped in curling bands. Droplet-shaped accents surround the beam, while her gloves, skirt, and ballet flats provide clear enclosed areas on a coloring sheet with a plain background.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Summoning Her Floating Heart-marked Shield Pal Companion Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ms. Chalice summoning her floating Shield Pal, raising an open hand beneath the smiling companion and its large heart emblem. Small wings, diamond sparkles, and looping motion lines surround the shield, giving the coloring sheet finer accents around the character's broad skirt and oversized shoes.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Releasing Spectral Warriors with Her Ghostly Barrage Super Art Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice releases spectral warriors with her Ghostly Barrage Super Art in this printable coloring page, extending one hand as two helmeted ghosts rise behind her. A spear, a sword, and a round shield distinguish the warriors, while curling wisps fill the coloring sheet around their tapered ghost tails.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Piloting Her Airplane Against Esther Winchester Above the Desert Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ms. Chalice piloting her airplane against Esther Winchester above the desert, with clouds between the two airborne opponents and mesas below. The foreground plane has riveted panels and rounded wings, while Esther's flying saloon and the distant cacti add smaller sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Climbing the Rope Ladder to the King of Games' Floating Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice climbs a rope ladder toward the King of Games' floating castle in this printable coloring page, looking upward as she grips the rungs. Twisted ropes and knotted ends make repeating details down the coloring sheet, while clouds and flag-topped towers surround the castle's small rocky island.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Receiving a Coin Reward From the King of Games Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ms. Chalice receiving a coin reward from the King of Games, reaching toward his large hand on a castle terrace. His jeweled crown, flowing beard, and clasped cape provide distinct details, while stone paving and distant towers frame the two figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Dash Parrying a Pawn's Head in the King's Leap Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice dash parries a Pawn's head in this printable coloring page from the King's Leap, leaping forward with an open palm beside a sharp impact burst. The round head hovers above its chess-piece body, while a crown banner, columns, and stone arches add castle details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Dodging the Knight's Sword in the King's Leap Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Ms. Chalice dodging the Knight's sword during the King's Leap, jumping beside an armored horse knight as his broad blade sweeps low. Curved motion lines emphasize the action, while the helmet, layered armor, stone floor, and hanging banner divide the coloring sheet into varied shapes.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Putting Out the Bishop's Candles in the Castle Chapel Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice puts out the Bishop's candles in this printable coloring page, blowing toward a smoking wick beneath the floating chess-piece character inside the castle chapel. Tall pointed windows, stone columns, and dripping candles create repeated details across the coloring sheet, with large open areas in the Bishop's hat and face.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Parrying a Flying Head Back Toward the Rook and His Grindstone Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ms. Chalice parrying a flying head back toward the Rook and his grindstone, jumping beside a star-edged impact burst. The Rook wears a battlement-shaped crown and stands behind a hand-cranked wheel, while sparks, motion trails, and scattered stones add details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Parrying a Cannon Fuse While the Queen Drops Jewels Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice parries a cannon fuse while the Queen drops jewels in this printable coloring page, leaping toward the sparkling fuse above the cannon's muzzle. Faceted gems fall between the characters, and the Queen's crown and patterned gown join spoked wheels and castle towers as smaller coloring sheet details.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Facing Glumstone the Giant on a Rocky Mountain Ledge Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ms. Chalice facing Glumstone the Giant on a rocky mountain ledge, standing with clenched gloves below his large bearded face. The giant's patched trousers and heavy boots contrast with her small figure, while jagged cliffs, distant snowy peaks, and scattered pebbles complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Battling the Moonshine Mob Spider Across Wooden Platforms Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice battles the Moonshine Mob Spider across wooden platforms in this printable coloring page, aiming a finger shot toward the grinning spider hanging above her. Its long jointed legs stretch between the platforms, while barrels, plank grain, and support beams add fine enclosed details throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Leaping Between Snowflake Platforms Around Mortimer Freeze Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Ms. Chalice leaping between snowflake platforms around Mortimer Freeze, with her arms spread as the wizard raises a snowflake-topped staff. Icicles hang beneath the floating platforms, and angular ice formations frame the coloring sheet around her broad skirt, gloves, and shoes.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Balancing on a Biplane During the Howling Aces Dogfight Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice balances on a biplane during the Howling Aces dogfight in this printable coloring page, bending her knees as a dog pilot approaches behind her. The large foreground wing, propeller, riveted panels, and crossed struts give the coloring sheet varied mechanical details against a sky of simple clouds.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Dodging Lime Slices During Chef Saltbaker's Bakery Battle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ms. Chalice dodging lime slices during Chef Saltbaker's bakery battle, leaping between flying citrus pieces as the chef stands behind her. Segmented fruit, a rolling pin, mixing bowls, and flour bags create numerous smaller spaces on this action-filled coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Sharing Pastries with Cuphead and Mugman at the Reopened Bakery Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice shares pastries with Cuphead and Mugman at the reopened bakery in this printable coloring page, holding a tray between her two smiling companions. Cupcakes, a pretzel, and a spiral pastry fill the tray, while display shelves of bread and cake add smaller food details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Talking to the Cactus Girl Beside Her Desert Campfire Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Ms. Chalice talking to the Cactus Girl beside her desert campfire, raising one hand while the flower-topped cactus character sits nearby. A ring of rounded stones surrounds the flames, and scattered pebbles, sparse plants, and a distant cactus complete the open desert coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Choosing a New Shot at Porkrind's Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice chooses a new shot at Porkrind's shop in this printable coloring page, pointing toward corked bottles while the eyepatched shopkeeper watches from behind the counter. Circle, diamond, and starburst emblems distinguish the bottles, with plank walls, shelves, and a barrel providing additional details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Dodging Moe Tato's Dirtballs in the Root Pack Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ms. Chalice dodging Moe Tato's dirtballs in the Root Pack garden, running across the soil as two round projectiles pass overhead. The potato boss rises behind her with an open mouth, while leafy vegetables, small stones, and rounded earth clumps add texture to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Facing Goopy Le Grande as He Bounces Through the Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice faces Goopy Le Grande as he bounces through the forest in this printable coloring page, standing with raised fists beneath the smiling round boss. His tiny hat and curved bounce trails distinguish the scene, while tree trunks, scalloped bushes, grass tufts, and stones frame the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Confronting Cagney Carnation Among Garden Flowers Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ms. Chalice confronting Cagney Carnation among garden flowers, holding one palm forward beneath the giant flower's pointed nose and wide grin. Layered petals and broad veined leaves distinguish Cagney, while smaller blossoms, bushes, a fence, and a winding path fill the detailed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Facing Ribby and Croaks Inside Their Riverboat Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice faces Ribby and Croaks inside their riverboat in this printable coloring page, raising her gloves opposite the two frog boxers on a plank floor. A large porthole reveals water and distant trees, while a hanging lantern, stairway, and railing establish the boat interior on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Battling Baroness Von Bon Bon Outside Her Candy Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Ms. Chalice battling Baroness Von Bon Bon outside her candy castle, facing the crowned boss and her tall spiral-lollipop staff. The Baroness's tiered gown offers large rounded sections, while striped candy towers, icing-like roof edges, and arched windows create repeated patterns across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Dodging Beppi the Clown's Bumper Car at the Carnival Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice dodges Beppi the Clown's bumper car at the carnival in this printable coloring page, running ahead of the grinning vehicle as Beppi grips its wheel. The car's oversized face, Beppi's pointed hat, circus tents, and strings of round lights add distinct shapes throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Jumping Across Clouds While Grim Matchstick Breathes Fire Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ms. Chalice jumping across clouds while Grim Matchstick breathes fire, with the three-headed dragon hovering beside her in the open sky. His horns, small wings, segmented necks, and pointed tail contrast with broad cloud shapes, giving the coloring sheet both fine details and larger spaces.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Flying Her Airplane Past Cala Maria and Her Electric Eels Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice flies her airplane past Cala Maria and her electric eels in this printable coloring page, steering beside the mermaid as eels leap from splashing water. Snake-shaped hair, a shell top, tail scales, and lightning symbols distinguish the scene, alongside the plane's wide wings and propeller on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Riding a Handcar Beside the Phantom Express Ghost Train Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Ms. Chalice riding a handcar beside the Phantom Express ghost train, gripping its pump handle as both tracks curve through rocky terrain. A smiling ghost floats near the locomotive's chimney, while spoked wheels, railway sleepers, and the train's large grinning face provide detailed sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Parrying King Dice's Marching Playing Cards Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice parries King Dice's marching playing cards in this printable coloring page, touching the heart card while King Dice watches from behind a stage curtain. Spade and club cards march alongside it, and the archway's round lights, patterned floor, and tall columns frame the action on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Facing the Devil and His Trident in the Casino Basement Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ms. Chalice facing the Devil and his trident in the casino basement, holding up her fists beneath the towering horned character. His pointed tail, shaggy outlines, split hooves, and three-pronged weapon contrast with the rounded gloves and skirt, while arched columns frame the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Ms. Chalice Flying a Plane Among Floating Columns Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice flies her airplane through Djimmi the Great's floating pillar maze in this printable coloring page, steering between patterned columns as the genie watches above. His feathered turban and curled mustache add smaller details, while the plane's propeller, broad wings, and rounded clouds create open areas across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms. Chalice Dodging a Falling Barrel on Captain Brineybeard's Dock Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ms. Chalice dodging a falling barrel on Captain Brineybeard's dock, leaning aside with open hands as the barrel drops overhead. Metal bands and rivets divide the barrel, while rope-wrapped posts, water ripples, and the dock's plank grain add smaller details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Ms. Chalice Tap Dancing Across a Rainbow Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice from The Cuphead Show tap dances across a rainbow in this printable coloring page, crossing her legs with both arms spread and one heel raised. Short tap marks surround her shoes, while parallel rainbow bands and rounded clouds give the coloring sheet long curved spaces around her full figure.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Ms. Chalice Competing Against the Devil in a Dance Contest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ms. Chalice competing against the Devil in a dance contest, both balancing on one leg between the stage's parted curtains. Musical notes, stars, and sparkles surround their raised arms, while a small trophy sits beside the Devil's feet on this Cuphead Show coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Ms. Chalice Tickling a Gumball Machine to Release Gumballs Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice tickles a gumball machine to release gumballs in this printable coloring page, reaching toward its smiling globe as round sweets spill from the tray. The machine's gloved hand, coin knob, and pedestal join Ms. Chalice's strapped shoes as smaller details on a coloring sheet with a plain background.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Ms. Chalice Charming a Hot Dog Vendor at His Cart Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Ms. Chalice charming a hot dog vendor at his cart, gesturing with an open hand beneath the cart's large striped umbrella. The bow-tied vendor holds serving tongs above the hot dogs, while condiment bottles, a spoked wheel, and a streetlamp add details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Ms. Chalice Floating Through a Broken Brick Wall Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice escapes through the cookie factory wall in her ghost form in this printable coloring page, floating past broken bricks with a long curling tail. A tray of dotted cookies, hanging lamp, arched window, and scattered rubble establish the factory setting around her open-handed pose on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Ms. Chalice Driving Elder Kettle's Truck with Cuphead and Mugman Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ms. Chalice driving Elder Kettle's truck with Cuphead and Mugman, all three smiling together behind the wide windshield on a country road. Round headlights, side mirrors, a broad bumper, and a horizontal grille divide the truck's large front, while trees and fencing border the coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Ms. Chalice Driving a Taxi During Turn Up the Charm Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice drives a taxi during Turn Up the Charm in this printable coloring page, smiling behind the wheel as the rounded cab follows a cobbled street. A checkered side stripe and roof sign distinguish the taxi, while window boxes, streetlamps, and distant arches fill the detailed Cuphead Show coloring sheet.

pages.title: Ghost Ms. Chalice Above Cuphead and Mugman Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows ghostly Ms. Chalice haunting a house while Cuphead and Mugman pose as ghost removers, looking up with a net and sack. Her curled ghost tail floats above their caps and overalls, while a moonlit window, candle sconce, and wooden paneling establish the room on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Cuphead Show Ms. Chalice Dressed as a Pirate in Mugman's Imagined Adventure Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice dresses as a pirate in Mugman's imagined adventure in this printable coloring page, holding a rolled map beside a ship's wheel and rope rigging. Her broad hat, long belted coat, striped trousers, and cuffed boots create varied clothing sections across this Cuphead Show coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms Chalice in Esther Winchester Desert Town Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ms. Chalice in Esther Winchester's desert town, winking with one finger raised as wooden storefronts line the sandy street behind her. A halo sits above her cup rim and striped straw, while cacti, mesas, clouds, and scattered stones provide simple background details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms Chalice in Porkrind Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice waves inside Porkrind's shop in this printable coloring page, standing beside a counter with a cash register and a small tray of coins. Shelves display bottles, stacked coins, a long gun, and heart-marked items, giving the coloring sheet smaller objects around her broad skirt and rounded shoes.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms Chalice in Carnival Grounds Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Ms. Chalice at the carnival grounds, waving beneath a halo while wearing a spotted skirt beside balloons and a Ferris wheel. A carousel horse stands under a flag-topped canopy, and the coloring sheet combines the character's large open shapes with repeating ride and clothing details.

pages.title: Cuphead Ms Chalice in Inkwell Isle Three Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms. Chalice waves and winks in Inkwell Isle Three in this printable coloring page, keeping one hand on her hip beside a cluster of crooked buildings. Her puffed sleeves, scalloped skirt, and rounded shoes fill the foreground, while trees, hills, and small grass tufts complete the coloring sheet's open landscape.
